author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
A map I made to test the new gamemode, CTF. It's very hacky, but once the actual game comes along I'll be sure to convert it.

Anyway, it's named Boolean, and it's a 25v25. There's a few catches to this map: supply chests, diagonally built, and the map is regioned exceptionally well to where you're restricted to the actual middle of the map and a bit behind, so you can't make insanely high skybridges or bridge out 50 blocks. This was tested before, see it in action! http://imgur.com/a/qyu0Y

Changelog:
- Fixed Flag Placement
- Removed Glitchy Drops

YAML Link, thanks to steven for contributing with the server and YML!
Download: not currently up, not comfortable sharing for stealing issues.
Image Album - Loadout

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

For a little background on the gamemode, you're supposed to run to the enemy's flag deposit, get the wool, run back, and take it into your spawn to win. This map is single-flag, which means there's only 1 flag to capture.

title: [CTF] Boolean

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body: How do you pick up a flag?
replies.body_tagged: How do you pick up a flag?

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: You run to the back of the map where the colored square is with your team color, walk through it, and you're granted wool. You can run through as many times as you like, but it's necessary to be stealthy so you don't get killed in the process. Run back to your base through front lines or wherever and go into your spawn, and put it in the hole.
